nodes.description: Public token name string, set once in the constructor.
Public token symbol string, set once in the constructor.
Public uint8 decimals value, fixed at 18 in the constructor.
Total token supply stored as uint256 and assigned in the constructor.
Mapping of holder address to token balance, mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested allowance mapping (owner => spender => amount) written by approve and transferFrom.
Constructor that initializes metadata, mint supply and credits msg.sender.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using an unchecked subtraction.
View function returning the balance of a supplied tokenOwner address.
View function returning the remaining allowance between owner and spender.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] to tokens and emits Approval.
Moves tokens from msg.sender to a recipient using safeSub/safeAdd balance updates.
Moves tokens using the allowance of msg.sender, updating balances and allowed.
SafeMath addition with overflow require check, returns uint c.
SafeMath subtraction with underflow require check, returns uint c.
SafeMath multiplication with overflow require check, returns uint c.
SafeMath division with divide-by-zero require check, returns uint c.
Caller-controlled address used as owner, minter and allowance spender key.
safeSub of balances[msg.sender] by tokens during transfer (arithmetic on user amount).
safeAdd of balances[to] by tokens during transfer (arithmetic on user amount).
safeSub of allowed[from][msg.sender] by tokens during transferFrom (arithmetic on allowance).
Unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] inside totalSupply.
Recipient address parameter of transfer and transferFrom.
Token amount parameter of approve, transfer and transferFrom.
Source address parameter of transferFrom whose balance and allowance are debited.
Address parameter of balanceOf and allowance used as mapping key.
Spender address parameter of approve and allowance used as mapping key.
Return local used by the SafeMath helpers to hold the arithmetic result.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns the name state variable.
Constructor assigns the symbol state variable.
Constructor assigns the decimals state variable.
Constructor assigns the initial _totalSupply.
Constructor credits the initial supply to the caller-controlled msg.sender.
balances mapping is keyed and written with the untrusted msg.sender address.
_totalSupply is an operand of the unchecked subtraction in totalSupply.
balances[address(0)] feeds the unchecked subtraction in totalSupply.
totalSupply executes the unchecked subtraction operation.
balanceOf reads its tokenOwner parameter.
tokenOwner is used as the key into the balances mapping.
allowance reads its tokenOwner parameter.
allowance reads its spender parameter.
tokenOwner indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner key.
approve consumes the spender parameter.
approve consumes the tokens parameter as the approved amount.
tokens is stored into the allowed mapping by approve.
transfer debits the balance of the caller msg.sender.
transfer consumes the tokens parameter.
transfer consumes the recipient to parameter.
tokens is subtracted from the sender balance in transfer.
Sender balance from the balances mapping is an operand of the subtraction.
Result of the safeSub balance subtraction is written back to balances.
Recipient to indexes the balances mapping for the credit.
tokens is added to the recipient balance in transfer.
Result of the safeAdd credit is written back to balances.
transfer calls safeSub for the sender balance debit.
transfer calls safeAdd for the recipient balance credit.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender of the allowance.
transferFrom consumes the from parameter.
transferFrom consumes the to parameter.
transferFrom consumes the tokens parameter.
from indexes the allowed mapping whose value is decremented by the subtraction.
tokens is subtracted from the spender allowance in transferFrom.
Reduced allowance is written back into the allowed mapping.
transferFrom calls safeSub for balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom calls safeAdd for the recipient balance credit.
safeAdd stores its result in the local variable c.
safeSub stores its result in the local variable c.
safeMul stores its result in the local variable c.
safeDiv stores its result in the local variable c.

normalization_plan.reason: The to parameter only carries recipient data into the transfer function and its balance write; it is not a core graph entity.
The tokens parameter is a transient amount input consumed by the transfer arithmetic operations and needs no independent node.
The from parameter only supplies the debited account address inside transferFrom.
The tokenOwner parameter is a pure lookup key for the balanceOf view and should fold into that function.
The spender parameter is a pure lookup key consumed by approve when writing the allowed mapping.
The local variable c is only the arithmetic result holder of the SafeMath functions and collapses into the safeAdd helper.
